title: Inspect Exact Queries Generating Impressions
diagnosticAction: In Google Search Console -> Performance -> Search Results, filter by the specific page URL and sort queries by Impressions descending where CTR is below site benchmark (< 3.5% for non-brand local queries).
implementationRule: Identify whether impressions come from general house cleaning queries, specific service queries (deep, recurring, move-in/out, post-construction), or pricing/FAQ queries.

title: Compare Title & Meta Description to Competing SERP Results
diagnosticAction: Inspect live Google SERP results for the primary query in the target Alabama city (Huntsville, Madison, Hampton Cove, Owens Cross Roads, or Athens).
implementationRule: Differentiate from generic directories (Angi, Yelp, Thumbtack) by highlighting verified Mojo Cleaning facts: 56-point checklist, 48-Hour Happiness Guarantee, and insured local teams.

title: Confirm the Page Matches the Searcher’s Intent
diagnosticAction: Verify that the ranking URL is the right destination for the query (e.g., deep-cleaning queries map to /{loc}/services/deep-house-cleaning/, not the general homepage).
implementationRule: If a page is receiving impressions for a different service intent, strengthen internal anchor links pointing to the dedicated service page.

title: Rewrite the Title for Clarity and Relevance
diagnosticAction: Ensure the primary service and verified city appear clearly at the start of the <title> tag within 45–65 characters.
implementationRule: Follow the verified pattern: "[Service] in [City], AL | Mojo Cleaning" without keyword stuffing or listing multiple cities.

title: Rewrite the Meta Description to Highlight Real Customer Benefits
diagnosticAction: Craft a 135–165 character meta description that summarizes the page’s exact scope and includes a clear quote invitation.
implementationRule: Never use fake urgency, unverified discounts, or exaggerated superiority claims.

title: Improve the Visible H1 and Opening Section
diagnosticAction: Ensure the visible <h1> and above-the-fold hero copy immediately confirm the searcher landed on the exact service and Alabama city they clicked for.
implementationRule: Include a prominent Request a Quote button and secondary click-to-call action above the fold so clicks convert into engaged visits.

title: Re-Test Performance Over a Defined 28-Day Measurement Period
diagnosticAction: Record the date of the title/description update and compare 28-day post-change Impressions, Clicks, CTR, and Average Position against the prior 28-day baseline in Google Search Console.
implementationRule: Retain snippet improvements that lift CTR and qualified quote submissions; iterate further if impressions grow without proportional click growth.
